mapper.select: SELECT id, password, nickname, name, gender, birth, phone, email, profile_image_uuid AS image_uuid, profile_image_original AS image_original, profile_image_url AS image_url, personal_color, body_shape, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO email_verification ev USING (SELECT #{email} AS email FROM dual) src ON (ev.email = src.email) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ev.token = #{token}, ev.expires_at = #{expires_at}, ev.verified = 'N' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (email, token, expires_at, verified) VALUES (#{email}, #{token}, #{expires_at}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT email, token, expires_at, verified FROM email_verification WHERE token = #{token}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} AND verified = 'Y' AND expires_at >= SYSDATE
